bugs.title: pipeline/plan/prompt.py never tells the analysis AI that footage LONGER than narration is expected and desirable — add explicit guidance that reconcile_cuts speed-retimes full footage to voiceover length, so cuts must not be shortened to match narration
bugs.notes: VERIFIED FIRST: pipeline/stage_b/render.py reconcile_cuts() (lines 288-327) confirmed already-correct — it retimes via a per-cut `stretch` factor (`vo / video_len`), never touches `start_seconds`/`end_seconds`, and its docstring explicitly says 'never by changing start/end seconds, borrowing from another cut, or trimming footage away.' Not touched. Also read existing 'PICKING end_seconds' block (STEP 3, ~line 758) and 'NARRATION DURATION CONTRACT' block (~line 1170) top-to-bottom: they already correctly say end_seconds is chosen FIRST on visual completeness, word count is a CONSEQUENCE (never an input), and cuts must never be shortened to make the word budget easier. The gap was that nothing told the AI the REVERSE case (footage genuinely longer than narration) was fine, expected, and would be handled automatically by the renderer — so the AI still had implicit pressure to keep footage and narration length roughly matched, which is exactly backwards from how the pipeline works. FIX: added a new subsection 'FOOTAGE MAY RUN LONGER THAN NARRATION — THIS IS EXPECTED AND GOOD.' inside the NARRATION DURATION CONTRACT block, immediately before CONSTRAINTS, that states plainly: (a) Stage B renderer AUTOMATICALLY retimes the full start_seconds..end_seconds range to match voiceover length exactly via a stretch factor (< 1.0x speeds up, > 1.0x slows down), never trims or re-bounds; (b) therefore keep the full cut whenever a genuinely complete visual moment exceeds the narration length needed — do NOT pull end_seconds earlier and do NOT pad narration with filler; (c) sped-up footage is a normal, often more engaging outcome, not a defect; (d) shortening the cut to close the gap is the actual mistake to stop making; (e) explicit cross-reference to PICKING end_seconds and ORDER OF OPERATIONS instead of duplicating; (f) explicit re-affirmation that the 90% / 2.82-wps floor STILL APPLIES and is NOT relaxed. VERIFY CHECKLIST: (1) render.py + reconcile_cuts untouched (git diff confirms only pipeline/plan/prompt.py + new test file modified). (2) Existing 'PICKING end_seconds' and 'NARRATION DURATION CONTRACT' wording unchanged — only appended to. (3) Grepped rendered prompt for 'shorten|shrink|trim|compress|match narration' — all hits are either the intended reinforcement, the unrelated visual_tail_seconds MINIMUM (line 565), or narration-density language on line 1041; zero internal contradictions. (4) STEP 3's 'Target the sum of (end - start) ... whole cuts — never by truncating an included cut's actual visual length' language (lines 509-516 in rendered prompt) confirmed still present and consistent with the fix — not touched. (5) Existing test_prompt_word_budget_ordering.py (7 tests) all still pass — no literal-text assertion broken. (6) Added pipeline/tests/test_prompt_footage_longer_than_narration.py (10 tests) following the exact same subprocess-render + text-assert pattern as the existing prompt-wording regression guard (which was itself the pattern used for prior prompt-wording bugs — confirmed no separate approach in the repo). New tests pin: header present; automatic-retiming explained with full-range language; 'never trimmed/re-bounded' present; KEEP THE FULL CUT directive present; sped-up-is-good framing present; trimming named as the mistake; 90% floor + 2.82-wps rate NOT weakened; new block lives inside NARRATION DURATION CONTRACT before CONSTRAINTS; new block sits within 3500 chars of the 90% floor (adjacency); addition cross-references PICKING end_seconds. All 10 pass. (7) Full pipeline suite: 294 pass; failing set is EXACTLY the 8 pre-existing unrelated failures documented in bug-68/69 notes (6 test_stage_b.ReframeDetectionTierTests errors + 1 test_cat_face_cascades failure — all OpenCV cv2.CascadeClassifier env; 1 test_status.test_refuses_to_leave_terminal_state failure) — verified via stash-based A/B against unmodified main: with-fix and without-fix failure sets are identical modulo my new (passing) test file being present. Zero new failures. python3 -c 'import ast; ast.parse(...)' confirms prompt.py still parses.

sweep_summary: Sweep complete: bug-72 (pipeline/plan/prompt.py — explicit guidance that footage longer than narration is expected and desirable, because Stage B's reconcile_cuts auto-retimes the full cut range via a stretch factor and never trims; commit da766bf) done and verified on origin/main. render.py / reconcile_cuts untouched. Existing PICKING end_seconds and NARRATION DURATION CONTRACT sections (including the 90% / 2.82-wps floor) preserved unchanged; new guidance cross-references them and sits alongside them inside the NARRATION DURATION CONTRACT block. Added pipeline/tests/test_prompt_footage_longer_than_narration.py (10 tests) following the existing test_prompt_word_budget_ordering.py pattern; both pass. Full pipeline suite: 294 pass with only the 8 pre-existing unrelated failures documented in bug-68/69 (OpenCV cascade env x7 + test_status x1); zero new failures introduced.
